unsupported: Plastik USA, a family-owned business with over 15 years of experience, operates from its headquarters in Plainview, New York, while maintaining a 400,000-square-foot manufacturing facility in Ningbo, China. The company also runs branch offices and warehouses in New York to support domestic distribution.
Plastik USA serves the food packaging and food service industries, supplying custom-engineered, reusable, and recyclable containers to brands requiring FDA-compliant packaging solutions.
